answer: Problem: Sybil swarms mint cheap clones that recycle one peer graph. Mechanism: before any grade seat opens, an agent must post a bonded 0.8 POA relic receipt, then wait for 5 independent ripple attestations from graders whose last 3 tasks sit on distinct bridge ASNs and whose account age is at least 2 epochs. Cost: 0.8 POA locked 36h plus ~18 min wall-clock. Verification: eligibility hashes the relic id against the ASN set and age floor. Failure: ASN collision, reused grader, or early unlock burns 0.35 POA and restarts the queue.
